##### Project general facts

Azizi Noura by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential building with a refined tiered design, where a slender vertical tower rises above a more substantial base. The facade combines light modern panels with elegant curved accents and generous balconies with glass railings, creating a sense of depth and sophistication. The building rises from a ground floor and three podium levels to eleven residential floors, offering studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments together with commercial units.

Residents enjoy swimming pools, fitness and wellness facilities and separate gyms for men and women for an active daily routine. A cinema, a game lounge, an indoor children's play area, an indoor multipurpose hall, lounges, a sun terrace and landscaped open areas add variety, while a welcoming lobby, lifts, spacious parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance provide everyday comfort and peace of mind for residents and their guests.

Residences feature thoughtful layouts, modern interiors and high-quality finishes, with large windows and balconies that bring natural light into the living spaces. Compact, efficient floor plans suit young professionals, couples and investors seeking practical homes close to major employment hubs. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali is one of the leading business and logistics hubs of Dubai, home to Jebel Ali Port, the largest port in the Middle East, and the Jebel Ali Free Zone, where thousands of international companies are based. Residential neighbourhoods, community retail, cafes, schools and clinics sit close to the business district, giving residents a practical setting close to their workplaces.

Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Life Pharmacy metro station is close by. Ibn Battuta Mall is a short drive away, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Jumeirah Lake Towers and Dubai Parks and Resorts are close by, and Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Jebel Ali offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most accessible entry prices in western Dubai. A large working population in the free zone and the port supports steady demand from tenants seeking homes close to their workplaces. Continued infrastructure investment around Expo City Dubai and Al Maktoum International Airport underpins attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
